elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Chrome is crawling and you have no idea which tab did it?

[confident] Here's the fix. Open Chrome's own task manager.

[friendly] On Windows, press Shift and Escape. Sort by memory, biggest first. Pick the hog and click End task.

[delighted] The one tab eating your memory is gone, and the rest stay open.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
coverLine: Chrome has its own task manager
